betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Space is trying to kill you. The §6Space Suit§f is the thing that stops it.

Craft the full set at the Suit Workstation: helmet, chest-piece, leggings, boots. The chest-piece is the core, it holds the oxygen supply and provides pressure sealing, thermal regulation, and knockback resistance from rocket exhaust.

Without the full set, you don't get pressure sealing, and partial suits won't keep you alive in vacuum. The internal tank holds about 30 minutes of oxygen, refilled at a Gas Charge Pad.

You need this for any mission beyond Earth-like worlds, every space station visit, and basically anywhere that isn't breathable air.

§cWARNING:§f Running out of oxygen in vacuum is instant death. Always refill at a Gas Charge Pad before leaving.
